_README: Q287: fibroglandular tissue in her CT breasts by an HU rule; see scripts/anatomy/q287/breast_fgt_q287.py.

references.what: dedicated breast CT, 137 breasts of 136 women (BI-RADS 4/5 work-up): volumetric glandular fraction mean 0.172 +/- 0.142, range 0.012-0.719, falling with age and with breast volume
references.cite: Vedantham S, Shi L, Karellas A, O'Connell AM. Dedicated breast CT: fibroglandular volume measurements in a diagnostic population. Med Phys 2012;39:7317-28

references.what: breast CT + mammographic volumetry, 2831 women: mean fibroglandular share 19.3 % (13.7-25.6 % by group, skin included), 80 % of women below 27 %
references.cite: Yaffe MJ, Boone JM, Packard N, et al. The myth of the 50-50 breast. Med Phys 2009;36:5437-43
